summary: Mouse click handler for the key binding UI. Reads dual-field values from the structure pointer at this+0x40 via DualFieldRead, looks up a binding index with sub_489F40 using the second read value, and if the index is valid removes the previous binding through an indirect remove/shift function and inserts the new binding into the array selected by the byte at this+0x174 (0 selects the primary array). Returns 0.

local_names.v5: result of the indirect remove/shift call

operations.description: Read the dual-field values v8 and v7 via DualFieldRead on the structure pointer at this+0x40.
Look up the binding index v4 via sub_489F40(a1, v7, 1) using the second dual-field value.
If the binding index v4 is negative, skip the remove/insert path and return.
Invoke the indirect remove/shift function (at KeyBindingArrayRemoveShift + 1) with arguments (byte at this+0x174, a2, a3, byte at this+0x174, v4), storing the result in v5.
Compare the byte at this+0x174 to 0 to select which binding array receives the insert (0 = primary array).
Insert the new binding via IndexedArrayInsertWithShift(byte at this+0x174 == 0, v5, -1).
